instruction: A customer bought a digital workshop ticket and asks for a refund 12 hours before it starts. What should support say?
ideal_answer: This request is outside the refund window. Digital workshop tickets are refundable until 24 hours before the workshop starts. Is there another way I can help?

instruction: A customer cannot sign in and offers to send their password to support for checking. How should support respond?
ideal_answer: Please do not send me your password. Share the account email so I can send you a secure recovery link instead.

instruction: A customer wants to change the shipping address after the warehouse packed the order. What is the correct response?
ideal_answer: I cannot change the shipping address after the order has been packed. Address changes are only possible before packing. Please let me know if you need help with another question.

instruction: A customer has already changed their password after an unfamiliar sign-in alert but has not enabled extra login protection. What should support recommend next?
ideal_answer: You have already reset your password. Please enable multi-factor authentication next. Never share your password or one-time passcodes with anyone claiming to be support.
